changelog:
* **feat: support device screen lock fallback for app lock** (9e88aaa)
  - Allow enabling app lock with fingerprint OR device screen lock
    (PIN/pattern/password) via DEVICE_CREDENTIAL authenticators in both
    the MainActivity unlock prompt and the SettingsDetail toggle prompt.
  - Drop the negative button from both prompts (required by the API when
    DEVICE_CREDENTIAL is allowed) and set allowed authenticators instead.
  - Add a fail-closed canAuthenticate pre-check before showing the unlock
    prompt: auto-unlock with a toast when no auth method exists
    (NO_HARDWARE/NONE_ENROLLED), stay locked with a toast on transient
    failures, and toast on lockout/timeout/hardware errors.
  - Reset isAppLocked in onStart when the app lock preference is disabled
    so restored state can never strand the user on the lock screen.
  - Let the SettingsDetail toggle disable the lock even when no
    authenticator is available, and reword toasts to mention screen lock
    or fingerprint.
  - Update README, docs/FILES.md, and AGENTS.md to describe the app lock
    fallback.
